newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Gazprom 1996 pre-tax rises to 45.09 trln rbls - AK&M.
newsitem.headline: Gazprom 1996 pre-tax rises to 45.09 trln rbls - AK&M.

text.p: NOTES -- *Figures for 1996 and 1995 provided by securities specialists AK&M, with reference to RAO Gazprom's consolidated 1996 financial results.
A Gazprom spokesman declined to confirm or deny the figures. The additional series of Gazprom 1995 results were previously received from the company.
AK&M said international accountants Price Waterhouse were Gazprom's auditors but did not say whether the numbers were prepared to international or Russian standards.

Russian accounting standards differ significantly from those normally supplied in the West. Russian accounts are designed to meet the requirements of the tax authorities. Russian companies can choose whether to show revenues and spending on a cash or accruals basis. Definitions of profit and assets differ significantly from those in the West, and converting Russian accounts to international standards can turn a profit into a loss.
Figures are not usually adjusted for inflation or the depreciation of the rouble, but the following data may be helpful.
